name: Insider Threat Demo
description: Starts the Meridian SOC insider threat demo: runs an Elastic workflow that posts the alert and starts the playbook run through this plugin.

settings_schema.header: The Elastic workflow calls back into this server with the callback secret. Both secrets are filled in at first boot on preview instances.

settings.help_text: Base URL of the Kibana project that runs the workflow.
API key allowed to run the workflow.
Shared with the workflow. At least 24 characters.
This server's site URL must be <instance>.<domain>; the workflow only calls back to that domain.
